management_liability.description: Statutory bodies have direct responsibility. Face personal liability for damages, membership bans, or fines. Management must undergo training. Continuous employee cybersecurity training required.

compliance_deadlines.registration: 2025-03-01 (re-registration for existing entities; 60 days for new)
compliance_deadlines.cybersecurity_audit: Within 24 months of listing (deadline 2026-12-31 for essential)

penalties.essential_entities: EUR 10,000,000 or 2% of global annual turnover
penalties.important_entities: EUR 7,000,000 or 1.4% of global annual turnover
